items.name: OpenSwarm
items.tagline: A swarm of agents, in the same place you work
items.description: Stop bolting AI onto your computer. OpenSwarm is an AI-first operating system where agents run the whole machine: apps create themselves, browsers control themselves, and swarms of agents work together. Your OS just became an infinite canvas, and your work just transformed from you doing one task at a time, to orchestrating dozens in parallel. Tell it what you want and a swarm of agents does the work with you at the helm.

items.name: Claude Haiku 5.5
items.tagline: Anthropic's fastest and most capable Haiku yet
items.description: Claude Haiku 5.5 is Anthropic's fastest and most capable small model, built for high-volume, cost-sensitive tasks like summarization, classification, coding subagents, customer support, and browser use.

items.name: OpenSEO
items.tagline: The open source Semrush alternative
items.description: Without good data, your agent gives generic advice. We provide the data, tools, and integrations your AI agent needs for SEO via MCP. Regular SEO is the foundation of good GEO, but we just released a new set of AI Visibility features as well.

items.name: Griffin by Tavus
items.tagline: World's First Human Interaction Model
items.description: Griffin is Tavus’s Human Interaction Model for face-to-face, real-time conversation. It sees, hears, and talks at the same time, responding to pauses, expressions, gestures, and what’s happening on camera. In a live one-minute video call, 48% of participants believed they were talking to a real person. Griffin-Lite is available as a research preview to select early testers, with full-duplex video-to-video interaction and 720p generation.

items.name: ChickyTutor
items.tagline: A private language tutor that knows you better every day.
items.description: Hi Product Hunt! I’m Phanos, founder of ChickyTutor. We’re returning with an interactive whiteboard that brings visual teaching into spoken language practice. Ask about a language pattern, see examples, work through an exercise and discuss it with your tutor all during the conversation. We’ve also partnered with L’école de français to combine teacher-led French classes with daily AI practice between lessons at chickytutor.com/hybrid/french, and released ChickyTutor on Android.

items.name: Cekura Bench
items.tagline: Speech-to-speech model benchmarks on live phone calls
items.description: Cekura Bench publishes voice AI benchmarks you can verify. Our new speech-to-speech benchmark tests 9 realtime voice models, including GPT Realtime 2.1, Gemini Live, Grok and Phonic, as complete phone agents on live calls: 82 scenarios, three runs each. Models are ranked on reliability, data accuracy, stalled calls, response time and cost, and every call transcript is public. Cekura Bench also covers voice agent benchmarks and STT benchmarks, with TTS benchmarks coming soon.

items.name: Claude for Google Workspace
items.tagline: Bring Claude directly into Google Docs, Sheets & Slides
items.description: Claude now works directly inside Google Docs, Sheets, and Slides. Ask it to draft and edit documents, analyze spreadsheets, write formulas, build charts, or create presentation slides — all without leaving your file. You can also create and edit Google Workspace files directly from Claude using the new connectors. No more copying and pasting between apps. Available in beta for all paid Claude plans.

items.name: KloudMate 2.0
items.tagline: AI-powered Full-Stack Observability & Agentic SRE-Ops
items.description: 3 years after launching as an AWS serverless monitoring tool, KloudMate returns to PH as a full-stack, AI-powered Observability & Agentic SRE-Ops platform. It unifies metrics, logs, traces, and more, while KloudMate AI helps teams investigate incidents, find root causes, and resolve tickets. From dashboards to instant answers, KloudMate is built for modern, distributed systems. KloudMate AI Modules - Assistant (Answers), Builder (Dashboards, Alarms), Investigator (RCA), Docs (Documentation).

items.name: NOVA CLI v1.0
items.tagline: AI developer in your terminal
items.description: Nova CLI is an AI teammate in your terminal. Describe what you want in plain words and Nova reads your project, makes the change, runs your own tests and build, fixes what it broke, and gives you an honest verdict on what it checked. 160+ AI models are included on paid plans, with no separate AI account or API keys to manage. It works with the tests and tooling you already have, so there is nothing new to set up. Try Nova for free and see what it can do for your next task, here in your terminal.

items.name: Polylane for Vercel
items.tagline: An AI on-call engineer for your Vercel apps
items.description: Keep shipping while Polylane watches your Vercel apps. Connect through the Vercel Marketplace to bring projects, deployments, domains and logs into one live graph. Agents catch regressions, investigate the root cause with evidence, and open a pull request with the permanent fix for your review.

items.name: Paw-Paw
items.tagline: A tiny desktop pet for your Mac that types along with you
items.description: A small illustrated animal sits in the corner of your Mac's screen, reacts as you type and click, and naps when you pause. Choose which season earns XP and unlock dozens of Paw-Paws and 100+ items as you level up. Free and native; one optional $2.99 add-on.

items.name: Off the Record
items.tagline: Block AI from transcribing your meetings.
items.description: Off the Record reshapes your voice in real time so people can understand you while AI notetakers and hidden interview copilots struggle to transcribe it.

items.name: tide
items.tagline: A Jitsi alternative that does a few things really well
items.description: tide is a simple, self‑hostable video conference service, alternative to Jitsi. It let's you host your own "meet.custom.domain" for a simple video conferencing environment with all core features you expect, including: link sharing, screen sharing, recording (server-side). A few things, done well.

items.name: Liquid Inference
items.tagline: LLM router where providers compete for every prompt
items.description: * Fully compatible with agentic coding tools: Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Cursor, Pi, Cline, and many more. Full multi-modal support. * Hundreds of open- and closed-weight models. Create routing rule presets or use our Auto routing algorithms. * Providers compete dynamically on price for every prompt, offering the lowest marginal cost. * Sign up for free with email, first 500 users get $20 of free inference. Receive 20% of referred fees as free inference, 10% for second-level referrals.

items.name: Hark
items.tagline: The personal AI that handles life before you have to
items.description: Hark Pro is a personal AI designed to take things off your plate, not add another chatbot to your day. It remembers what matters, thinks ahead about what you might need, and uses its own cloud computer to get things done across the web — from managing calendars and email to shopping, travel, bills, and everyday errands. Your sensitive credentials stay encrypted, Hark never sells your data or shares it with advertisers, and you can watch it work.

items.name: BotBus
items.tagline: Manage your local coding agents from your phone
items.description: BotBus connects local coding agents to your phone. Manage Codex, Claude Code, Hermes, OpenCode, DeepSeek Harness and more across computers. Continue supported tasks, handle approvals, view files and PDFs, and use a terminal. macOS adds screen control and shared web previews. Hosts: macOS, Linux, Windows. Mobile: iPhone, Apple Watch, Android APK. Your computer stays online; capabilities vary by connector.

items.name: Markdoc
items.tagline: A shared Markdown editor for people and their agents
items.description: Write Markdown with the source and an editable preview side by side, live for everyone in the document. Review with comments and suggestions, bring your own agent over MCP, and publish straight to a gist or a repository file.

items.name: offstage
items.tagline: Your computer-use agent gets a Mac account, not your screen
items.description: offstage gives Claude Code, Codex and opencode a second, logged-in macOS account to work in. Simulators, Xcode UI tests and the app your agent just built open on that account's desktop, so your screen, keyboard and mouse stay yours. Free and open source: https://github.com/viraatdas/offstage

items.name: Udon
items.tagline: Control deck for your Mac home server with AI sysadmin.
items.description: Udon brings self-hosted apps, containers, storage, and monitoring together on your Mac mini or any Apple Silicon Mac. Manage it all from your browser, mobile companion or tell the built-in AI assistant what you need.

items.name: Tractionwave
items.tagline: AI attention heatmaps for ads to check before you spend
items.description: TractionWave evaluates ads and marketing visuals with AI attention prediction — a heatmap and ranked hotspots in seconds. Know it gets seen before the budget goes live.
